head: 3e5582023cfff884540db66da5a733836ac0fe0a
claim: A developer can upgrade to @byokit/cloud 0.5.0 and reach a cloud computer over SSH only: the app is carried through one SSH forward to the machine's loopback, nothing joins a tailnet.

steps.start: Repository worktree at commit 3e558202 (fm/byk-release-cloud-050), clean, npm workspace built with npm run build. No prior cloud VM running. The Ubuntu 24.04 cloud image was downloaded and its sha256 checked against Ubuntu's SHA256SUMS. A fresh ED25519 key was generated in a scratch folder.
steps: Ran npm run build; it exited 0 and @byokit/cloud/ssh resolved to packages/cloud/dist.
Started the KVM VM from the Ubuntu 24.04 image with a cloud-init seed that creates user ada with the scratch key, inside the byokit qemu container, on a loopback-only SSH port.
Waited for cloud-init to finish and read the ED25519 host key printed on the serial console.
Connected with the system ssh binary through sshHostKey() and compared the fingerprint with the console key; they matched, and I confirmed it.
Ran setup() with @byokit/cloud/ssh and no address, with a recipe that installs Node 24.15.0 and a small host on 127.0.0.1:7300. The steps were checking-access, listing, inspecting, installing, ready.
Resolved the link address through sshResolve() over sshTransport(), which opened one ssh -N -L forward; the address was rewritten to a local port.
Sent a request through the forward and received the host's answer, 'runner up for Ada'.
Checked the box's listeners (only 127.0.0.1:7300) and tailscale (none, inactive).
Closed the forward and resolved again; a new local port was opened and the request succeeded.
Connected with a wrong pinned host key and got the host-key error: 'the pinned host key no longer matches'.
Stopped and removed the VM container; no byk containers remain.
steps.result: The terminal output ends with result: PASS. A user sees the cloud computer reached through a single SSH forward to its loopback port, with no tailnet step, a listener only on 127.0.0.1:7300, tailscale not running, and a changed host key refused with host-key. The upgrade from an older install to 0.5.0 was not driven; this run used the built 0.5.0 workspace package directly.

verdicts.seen: I read all 12 capture records. host-key shows matchesConsole true. steps reach "ready". resolved is ws://127.0.0.1:42857 and host-answer-through-forward returns "runner up for Ada". listeners-7300 is 127.0.0.1:7300 only. tailscale-on-box is none, and the service is inactive. The wrong-pin record is a negative check and shows the mismatch is rejected. The result is PASS with EXIT=0. These support the loopback-forward, no-tailnet, working-app parts of the outcome. Nothing in the capture shows the version 0.5.0 being installed, so that part is unverified. I therefore rate correct as likely but not certain. The outcome names no separate parts, so parts and covers are empty.
